senses.gloss: m. (= קְטַע) to cut, pluck; (cmp. קְטַף) to harvest.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 8:3:16">Y. Ter. VIII, 45ᵈ</cite> top (proverbial expression) <he>אין ק׳ ק׳ שיחור וכ׳</he> if he plucks (gains anything), he plucks a piece of coal, if he loses, he loses a pearl (i.e. he risks his life for a trifle); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 2:3:14">Y. Ab. Zar. II, 41ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>ק׳ שידו</he> (corr. acc.).
